body:
# WORLD TRIGGER

This mod adds many aspects from the anime World Trigger into your very own Minecraft world.

![Raygust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53d78694fcea3c0da1a4e42d711ed438cf592603.png)

## Q&A

Why should you install this mod? - It adds a variety of weapons and loadout customization, and adds new enemies to fight.

What does it add? - 13+ different triggers (weapons), 4+ neighbors (enemy mobs), and a new ore type (trion) to craft an assortment of different blocks and tools. 

How should I report issues/bugs or give suggestions? - In the discord at the bottom of the description.

What happens if this project becomes abandoned? - I will most likely open source the project to allow other people to use the project however they wish (if it becomes popular or the demand to open source is there).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## How to start

This mod currently adds weapons and enemies from the anime World Trigger. To start you get craft a trigger, a trigger bench, and a kogetsu. You right click on the trigger to initiate it. Then you click on the trigger bench to open up the menu, you put your trigger and the chips into the bench and click finish. You then right click to activate. Afterwards you get more chips by fighting neighbors (enemy mobs).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Information

This mod is a passion project so updates may not be uploaded on a consistent schedule. Please report any issues you experience in the discord.
